title: Étale-local integral monodromy and exact rational realization
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$ and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $A=\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For a scheme $T$, use the continuous-function coefficient sheaves $A_T$ and $E_T$ of [def-weil-pbc-lisse-lattice-coefficients]; modules mean sheaf modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] on $T_{\mathrm{proét}}$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. A module is lisse if it is pro-étale locally free of finite rank, with rank zero allowed.

For every connected quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme $T$ with Noetherian underlying topological space (every ascending chain of open subsets stabilizes) and geometric point $\bar t$, put $\Pi_T=\pi_1(T,\bar t)$, the profinite étale fundamental group of [def-galois-fibre-functor]. Let $\operatorname{Rep}^{\mathrm{cont}}_E(\Pi_T)$ have as objects finite-dimensional $E$-vector spaces $V$ with jointly continuous $E$-linear $\Pi_T$-action, with the usual finite-dimensional $\ell$-adic topology; its morphisms are equivariant $E$-linear maps. There is an $E$-linear fully faithful functor
$$J_T:\operatorname{Rep}^{\mathrm{cont}}_E(\Pi_T)\longrightarrow\operatorname{Mod}(T_{\mathrm{proét}},E_T).$$
Its values are lisse. It sends every short exact sequence of representations whose underlying sequence of $E$-vector spaces is exact to a short exact sequence in the ambient sheaf-module category. Its normalization on an invariant finite free $A$-lattice $B\subset V$ is
$$J_T(V)\cong\left(\varprojlim_{n\ge1}\nu^*\mathcal L(B/\varpi^nB)\right)[1/\ell],$$
where $\nu:T_{\mathrm{proét}}\to T_{\mathrm{ét}}$ and its module inverse image $\nu^*$ are the site-comparison morphism and inverse image of [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism], and $\mathcal L(B/\varpi^nB)$ is the finite locally constant étale sheaf corresponding to the finite discrete continuous $\Pi_T$-module $B/\varpi^nB$ under [cor-galois-lisse-representations](1). Here an invariant finite free lattice means a $\Pi_T$-stable finite free $A$-submodule $B$ with $E\otimes_A B\cong V$. The isomorphisms are compatible with equivariant maps, independently of the invariant lattice. In particular the functor is the integral-monodromy realization followed by inversion of $\ell$, rather than a choice of unrelated realizations.

Let $S$ be any scheme [def-pc-scheme] with Noetherian underlying topological space. For every finite diagram $(L_a,f_b)$ of lisse $E_S$-modules (a finite list of objects and morphisms with specified sources and targets) there is an étale covering family $u_i:T_i\to S$ by connected qcqs schemes with Noetherian underlying topological space, geometric points $\bar t_i$, and finite diagrams $(V_{a,i},h_{b,i})$ in $\operatorname{Rep}^{\mathrm{cont}}_E(\Pi_{T_i})$ with isomorphisms $J_{T_i}(V_{a,i})\cong u_i^{-1}L_a$ that identify every $J_{T_i}(h_{b,i})$ with $u_i^{-1}f_b$. An empty base has the empty covering. No invertibility assumption on $\ell$ on $S$, no ring-theoretic Noetherianity and no separation hypothesis on $S$ is imposed.

theorem etale_local_monodromy_realization (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : Type (u + 1)) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E] :
    ∃ R : ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (p : SfMonodromyPoint T), SfMonodromyRealization l E p,
      ∀ (S : Scheme.{u}) [TopologicalSpace.NoetherianSpace S]
        (A B : Type (u + 1)) [Finite A] [Finite B] (s t : B → A)
        (L : A → SfRationalModules l E S) (f : ∀ b : B, L (s b) ⟶ L (t b)),
        (∀ a : A, (L a).IsFiniteLocallyFree) →
          ∃ (I : Type (u + 1)) (Y : I → S.Etale),
            S.smallEtaleTopology.CoversTop Y ∧ (IsEmpty S → IsEmpty I) ∧
            ∃ (p : ∀ i : I, SfMonodromyPoint (Y i).left)
              (V : ∀ i : I, A → SfContinuousRepresentations l E (p i))
              (h : ∀ (i : I) (b : B), V i (s b) ⟶ V i (t b))
              (e : ∀ (i : I) (a : A),
                ((R (Y i).left (p i)).functor.obj (V i a)).val ≅
                  (PresheafOfModules.pushforward
                    (ProEtale.lisseEtaleCoefficientIdentificationSized l E (Y i).hom)).obj
                      (L a).val),
              ∀ (i : I) (b : B),
                ((R (Y i).left (p i)).functor.map (h i b)).val ≫ (e i (t b)).hom =
                  (e i (s b)).hom ≫
                    (PresheafOfModules.pushforward
                      (ProEtale.lisseEtaleCoefficientIdentificationSized l E (Y i).hom)).map
                        (f b).val
